_comment: Every call the kit makes. All are reads: Azure Resource Graph queries (az graph query) and Azure Resource Manager GETs (az rest --method get) on the commercial Azure host management.azure.com. 'role' is the least-privileged built-in role that can make the call; Reader holds */read. 'verified' is true where the query, path, API version and property names were read on the cited Microsoft Learn page; a live invoker refuses an unverified call unless -AllowUnverified, and Lab 2 confirms it. Fixture mode reads tests/fixtures/<week>/<fixture>; a keyed call's fixture is a map from the lower-cased key to the response.

calls.note: The guide's Step 1 query, ordered for paging

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, ip = tostring(properties.ipAddress), fqdn = tostring(properties.dnsSettings.fqdn), sku = tostring(sku.name), ddosMode = tostring(properties.ddosSettings.protectionMode), attachedTo = tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id), natGateway = tostring(properties.natGateway.id), owner = tostring(tags['owner'])
calls.note: The guide's Step 2 query, with the DNS name and NAT gateway added

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, sku = tostring(sku.name), frontDoorId = tostring(properties.frontDoorId), owner = tostring(tags['owner'])
calls.note: The guide's Step 2 query, with the Front Door ID the X-Azure-FDID header carries

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, owner = tostring(tags['owner'])
calls.unverified: the classic resource type in Resource Graph is the ARM type; Learn's migration page doesn't show a Resource Graph query

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, skuTier = tostring(properties.sku.tier), wafPolicy = tostring(properties.firewallPolicy.id), sslPolicy = properties.sslPolicy, frontendIPConfigurations = properties.frontendIPConfigurations, gatewayIPConfigurations = properties.gatewayIPConfigurations, owner = tostring(tags['owner'])
calls.unverified: sslPolicy and the IP configuration arrays are the ARM properties; the guide's Step 2 query projects only the tier and WAF policy

query: | project id, name, type, subscriptionId, publicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), privateEndpoints = array_length(properties.privateEndpointConnections), owner = tostring(tags['owner'])
calls.note: The guide's Step 2 query; the property's name and values vary by service, so it is a starting list

query: | project id, type, ipConfigurations = properties.ipConfigurations, gatewayIPConfigurations = properties.gatewayIPConfigurations, frontendIPConfigurations = properties.frontendIPConfigurations
calls.unverified: the kit's own query to find the virtual network behind a public IP; the property names are the ARM ones

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, ddosEnabled = tobool(properties.enableDdosProtection), ddosPlan = tostring(properties.ddosProtectionPlan.id), subnets = properties.subnets
calls.unverified: enableDdosProtection and ddosProtectionPlan are the properties az network vnet update sets

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, virtualNetworks = properties.virtualNetworks
| project id, name, enabled = tobool(properties.enabled), scopes = properties.scopes, criteria = properties.criteria.allOf, actions = properties.actions

| project id, name, subscriptionId, policySettings = properties.policySettings, managedRuleSets = properties.managedRules.managedRuleSets, customRules = properties.customRules, applicationGateways = properties.applicationGateways
calls.unverified: the property names are the ones the guide's Validate query reads (policySettings.mode, requestBodyCheck, managedRules.managedRuleSets)

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, sku = tostring(sku.name), policySettings = properties.policySettings, managedRuleSets = properties.managedRules.managedRuleSets, customRules = properties.customRules.rules, securityPolicyLinks = properties.securityPolicyLinks
calls.unverified: the Front Door WAF policy's ARM property names

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, tier = tostring(properties.sku.tier), threatIntelMode = tostring(properties.threatIntelMode), idpsMode = tostring(properties.intrusionDetection.mode), tlsInspection = isnotempty(properties.transportSecurity), firewalls = properties.firewalls
calls.unverified: the property names are the ones the guide's Validate query reads (threatIntelMode, intrusionDetection.mode)

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, tier = tostring(properties.sku.tier), policy = tostring(properties.firewallPolicy.id), ipConfigurations = properties.ipConfigurations
| project id, name, subscriptionId, routes = properties.routes, subnets = properties.subnets
calls.unverified: routes[].properties.addressPrefix, nextHopType and nextHopIpAddress are the values az network route-table route create sets
the CAF page names the type in its policy, not in a Resource Graph query

query: | project id, zone = tostring(split(id, '/virtualNetworkLinks/')[0]), vnet = tostring(properties.virtualNetwork.id), registration = tobool(properties.registrationEnabled)
calls.unverified: that Resource Graph returns virtual network links, and the case of '/virtualNetworkLinks/' in their IDs

query: | project id, name, subscriptionId, connections = properties.privateLinkServiceConnections, subnet = tostring(properties.subnet.id)

| project id, name, subscriptionId, rbac = tobool(properties.enableRbacAuthorization), purgeProtection = tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection), defaultAction = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction), publicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), privateEndpointConnections = properties.privateEndpointConnections, owner = tostring(tags['owner'])
calls.note: The properties the guide's Step 8 Validate query reads

query: | project id, name, displayName = tostring(properties.displayName), scope = tostring(properties.scope), definitionId = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionId), enforcementMode = tostring(properties.enforcementMode), notScopes = properties.notScopes, identityType = tostring(identity.type)
calls.note: The type and properties Learn's 'Compliance states for all policy assignments' sample reads; enforcementMode and notScopes from the assignment structure page

query: | project id, name, assignmentId = tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId), category = tostring(properties.exemptionCategory), expiresOn = tostring(properties.expiresOn), description = tostring(properties.description)
calls.note: From Learn's 'Policy exemptions per assignment' and 'Policy exemptions that expire within 90 days' samples; the kit keeps every exemption, expired ones too

query: | extend resourceId = tostring(properties.resourceId), policyAssignmentId = tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId), policyAssignmentScope = tostring(properties.policyAssignmentScope), policyAssignmentName = tostring(properties.policyAssignmentName), policyDefinitionId = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionId), policyDefinitionReferenceId = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId), stateWeight = iff(complianceState == 'NonCompliant', int(300), iff(complianceState == 'Compliant', int(200), iff(complianceState == 'Conflict', int(100), iff(complianceState == 'Exempt', int(50), int(0)))))
| summarize max(stateWeight) by resourceId, policyAssignmentId, policyAssignmentScope, policyAssignmentName
| summarize counts = count() by policyAssignmentId, policyAssignmentScope, max_stateWeight, policyAssignmentName

| summarize overallStateWeight = max(max_stateWeight), nonCompliantCount = sumif(counts, max_stateWeight == 300), compliantCount = sumif(counts, max_stateWeight == 200), conflictCount = sumif(counts, max_stateWeight == 100), exemptCount = sumif(counts, max_stateWeight == 50) by policyAssignmentId, policyAssignmentScope, policyAssignmentName
| extend totalResources = todouble(nonCompliantCount + compliantCount + conflictCount + exemptCount)
| extend compliancePercentage = iff(totalResources == 0, todouble(100), 100 * todouble(compliantCount + exemptCount) / totalResources)

| project policyAssignmentName, scope = policyAssignmentScope, complianceState = iff(overallStateWeight == 300, 'noncompliant', iff(overallStateWeight == 200, 'compliant', iff(overallStateWeight == 100, 'conflict', iff(overallStateWeight == 50, 'exempt', 'notstarted')))), compliancePercentage, compliantCount, nonCompliantCount, conflictCount, exemptCount
calls.note: Learn's 'Compliance by policy assignment' sample, as published

calls.unverified: the origin group list and its healthProbeSettings were not read; the version is the origins page's
tlsSettings.minimumTlsVersion and its values were not read
parameters.wafPolicy.id and parameters.associations[].domains[].id were not read
